A few things to know.

Is LumiBrain™ suitable for my child?

The supplied product materials describe social-skills training for children with autism who can engage with the tasks. Suitability depends on developmental abilities, sensory tolerance, headset fit and the device manufacturer's age guidance. Ask a qualified professional before starting.

Does this replace professional intervention?

No. VR practice is intended to support a broader care plan. Real-world skill transfer and individual outcomes should be reviewed with a professional.

How do partner discount codes work?

Enter your partner's code during checkout. A valid code applies the eligible offer and attributes the order to the partner. This preview uses demonstration codes only; live discounts and commission rules will be confirmed before sales launch. Offers apply to the subscription only. Offers apply to the subscription only.

Can I pay on this website now?

The supplied PayPal button is available in checkout, using USD and the merchant-configured amount. Local prices and demo discounts are not sent to PayPal. Confirm the item, total and rental terms before payment.

What if my child feels uncomfortable in VR?

Use adult supervision and stop if discomfort, dizziness or distress occurs. A professional should guide session duration and sensory adjustments.
